name: BOPP Packing Tape
shortDescription: BOPP packing tape coated with pressure-sensitive acrylic adhesive for carton, parcel and general sealing applications.
description: Bio Oriented Polypropylene (BOPP) Packing Tape is supplied in clear and tan options and is coated with pressure-sensitive acrylic-based adhesive. The tape is available in various coating thicknesses, with 45 microns identified as the standard in Sri Lanka. It is suitable for sealing carton boxes, parcels and stationery purposes, with customized printing options available.
features: Single or multiple colour printing available

name: BOPP Colour Packing Tape
shortDescription: Premium BOPP tape available in vibrant colours for secure sealing, identification and presentation.
description: BOPP Colour Packing Tape is made from Biaxially Oriented Polypropylene film and is designed for professional packaging applications. It provides strong adhesion, smooth sealing and durable performance while offering colour options that support brand visibility, identification and presentation.
features: Resistance to moisture and temperature variations

name: Kraft Paper Water Activated Tape
shortDescription: Recyclable water-activated kraft paper tape for general, export and heavy-duty carton packaging.
description: Water Based Acrylic Kraft Paper Tape is a general-purpose packaging tape used for carton sealing. The gummed tape is activated by water and is described as 100% recyclable, environmentally friendly, with very good adhesion and strong tensile strength. It can also be printed for advertising purposes.

name: Masking Tape
shortDescription: Easy-to-tear pressure-sensitive paper tape designed mainly for painting and masking applications.
description: Masking Tape is a pressure-sensitive tape made from thin, easy-to-tear paper with an adhesive designed to allow removal without leaving deposits or damaging the surface. It is mainly used for painting and masking and is also used in packaging, printing and garment industries.

name: Aluminium Foil Tape
shortDescription: High-performance aluminium foil tape for HVAC, electrical shielding, insulation and technical applications.
description: Aluminium Foil Tape is engineered with a thin aluminium foil backing and strong pressure-sensitive adhesive. It offers resistance to moisture, heat, UV radiation and chemicals. Its reflective and conductive properties make it suitable for industrial, commercial and technical applications.

name: Double Side Tissue Tape
shortDescription: Double-sided tissue tape designed for strong, discreet bonding between two surfaces.
description: Double Side Tissue Tape is produced by applying pressure-sensitive adhesive to both sides of a tissue carrier. It is easy to rip and is designed to bond two objects together, often where the final bond is intended to remain hidden.

name: Filament Tape
shortDescription: Fiberglass-reinforced pressure-sensitive tape for packaging applications requiring additional strength and durability.
description: Filament Tape is a pressure-sensitive adhesive tape reinforced with embedded fiberglass filament. The reinforcement provides increased strength and supports long-lasting bonds. Different filament structures can be selected according to the weight and size of the product, including cross-weave structures for particularly heavy applications.

name: PVC Duct Tape
shortDescription: Strong, flexible and waterproof PVC duct tape for sealing, bundling, securing and industrial applications.
description: PVC Duct Tape is used for sealing air ducts and surfaces, bundling and securing materials such as cables and pipes, and a range of industrial, plumbing and electrical applications. Its strong, flexible and waterproof properties also support floor marking, safety areas, temporary patching and long-term sealing.

name: PVC Floor Marking Tape
shortDescription: Self-adhesive floor marking tape for safety, organization and traffic management.
description: PVC Floor Marking Tape is used to create visual markings on floors for safety, organization and traffic management in industrial, commercial and public spaces. It can mark hazards, divide spaces, create aisles and provide directions.

name: LLDPE Stretch Film
shortDescription: Stretch film for wrapping, bundling and securing products during shipping, storage and transportation.
description: LLDPE Stretch Film is used to wrap, bundle and secure products during shipping, storage and transportation. Its high tensile strength, puncture resistance and stretchability allow it to conform tightly around products while helping protect against shifting, dust, moisture and other damage.

name: Shrink Film
shortDescription: Heat-shrinkable polymer film for protecting and securing products for retail, shipping and display.
description: Shrink Film is a polymer plastic film that shrinks tightly around an item when heat is applied. It provides protection and helps secure products for retail, shipping and display. Common types include polyolefin, PVC and polyethylene films for different applications.
